issue.title: Fetch Gmail thread metadata without message bodies through Discovery threads.get format=metadata

task_type_fields.proposal:
Make `Gog::thread_metadata` (`src/native/gmail/gog.rs:241`) fetch message metadata only, not full bodies.

Today it runs plain `gog gmail thread get <id>`. gog v0.44.0 through v0.48 has no `--format` flag on that command and always calls `Threads.Get(...).Format("full")`, so it downloads every message body (bob-cli-ii.2 note #1 records the gog source check). Bob throws the bodies away. The callers are `bob gmail search`, `peek`, `list -r`, send recovery, and since bob-cli-ii the `bob gmail sync` watch loop, which fetches every watched thread every 15 minutes on the Mac.

Suggested remedy, with no upstream change needed: commit 063f9c23 already moved sync discovery to Gmail's own Discovery method (`gog api call gmail v1 gmail.users.threads.list --params … --scope …gmail.readonly --no-cache` with `--enable-commands api.call,api.gmail.users.threads.list`). Call `gmail.users.threads.get` the same way, with `"format":"metadata"` and `metadataHeaders` for From, To, Cc, Bcc, Subject, Date, Message-ID, Auto-Submitted, X-Autoreply, X-Autorespond, Precedence, and Content-Type, which are the headers `src/native/gmail/turn.rs` classifies on.

Work items:
- Map the raw API thread shape into `GmailThread` (or add a raw-shape parser).
- Add the threads.get handler and its policy check to `tests/gmail_support/fake_gog.py`.
- Keep the `tests/gmail_turns.rs` header-contract test green.
- Confirm the payload `Content-Type` that marks a `multipart/report` bounce survives `format=metadata`.

Alternative: propose `--format metadata --headers …` on `gmail thread get` to openclaw/gogcli, then switch to it behind a version check.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-ii phases met the plan's correctness contract with the full-format read: the classifier sees every header it needs. Cutting bandwidth and keeping bodies off the wire is an efficiency and privacy improvement to a shared Gmail read that bob-cli-hg introduced, and it changes the transport for five callers. The bob-cli-ii.2 worker recorded it as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP rather than in-scope work, and the bob-cli-ii land agent agreed it is distinct from the epic's remaining defects.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-ii.2 note #3 and triaged by the bob-cli-ii land agent: every bob gmail sync watch run and every search/peek/list -r read downloads full message bodies Bob discards, because gog's thread get has no metadata format.
